record.question: Which region is known as the "Lungs of the World"?
record.explanation: Answer D: Amazon. Amazon is conventionally nicknamed the “lungs of the world.” That is a metaphorical sobriquet in the question; it should not be explained as a literal claim that the forest supplies most of Earth’s net oxygen. NASA discusses the phrase while distinguishing the nickname from the forest’s net oxygen balance. Reference: https://earthobservatory.nasa.gov/features/Deforestation/deforestation_update3.php. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
